finding.description: The first-cash wrapper required EXTERNAL_CUSTOMER evidence and a customer/receipt referent but did not bind that evidence to the customerRef on the fulfilment state. A structurally valid receipt from another customer could therefore mark the wrong sprint accepted.

hostileTestsAdded: acceptance from a different customer cannot prove accepted delivery
acceptance without explicit customer binding cannot prove accepted delivery
acceptance bound to the sprint customer can prove accepted delivery
rejection from a different customer is rejected too

verification.note: Previous CI runner failures do not prove this source head and are not reused as green or red evidence.

remainingSoftwareEvidenceGap: Run focused night-payment tests and canonical repository gates on an actual runner/repository host against the exact current branch head.
